title: Nabonidus and Belshazzar: A Study of the Closing Events of the Neo-Babylonian Empire
publisher: Yale University Press (Yale Oriental Series Researches 15)

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read the OCR text

pp. 96–97: oath formulas dated in Nabonidus's 12th year swear by Nabonidus, king of Babylon, "and Belshazzar, the son of the king" (Pinches; two Yale tablets) — no other oath in the name of a king's son; pp. 196–197: "third ruler" read as third after Nabonidus and Belshazzar (first suggested by Grotius); notes Torrey's alternative reading; Genouillac's Nabonidus-behind-Nebuchadnezzar thesis called "extremely hypothetical"
